object.attr: derived: CF-E29. Windows finds a program looked up by bare name in the current folder first, and the MCP server usually runs in the repository, so a program in a pulled commit would run (D-E19).
object.description: When Mellon looks for draw.io desktop, Mellon shall leave out the repository folder and the current folder unless MELLON_DRAWIO names a program in one of the two folders.
